info.name: Decco.API
info.description:
Decco.API — the core. Every endpoint is a POST that carries the Decco.Contracts envelope:
`{ "data": …, "metadata": null, "culture": "pt-BR" }` → `{ "data": …, "status": 0|1|2, "error": … }` (0 Success, 1 PartialSuccess, 2 Fail).

Global variables (import Decco.postman_globals.json): `decco_baseUrl`, `access_token` (sent as Bearer; not validated yet), `culture` and one `<entity>_id` per resource.

Flow: **Insert** stores the new Id in `<entity>_id` and `<entity>_created_id`, so Get → Update → Delete act on that record. **Update** and **Delete** refuse to run on an Id that was not created by Insert (seed data stays intact); set `<entity>_created_id` to the same value to override on purpose.

The request and response field names are Portuguese because Decco.Contracts 3.0.0 still is (see Decco.Database README / decco-compass reference/28).

exec: // Every envelope endpoint answers HTTP 200; failures travel inside the envelope (status 2).
pm.test("Envelope status is not Fail (2)", () => pm.expect(json.status).to.not.eql(2));
